title: Counting Irreducible polynomials with coefficients from thin subgroups
summary: L. Bary-Soroker and R. Shmueli (2026) have given an asymptotic formula for the number of irreducible polynomials over the finite fields $\mathbb F_q$ of $q$ elements, such that their coefficients are perfect squares in $\mathbb F_q$ and also extended this to classes of polynomials with coefficients described by finitely many unions of intersections of polynomial images. Here we use a different approach, which allows us to obtain another generalisation of this result to polynomials with coefficients from small subgroups of $\mathbb F_q^*$.
